title: Edit a patient's details
summary: Change the name, contact, ID, mutual society, default doctor or responsible contact from Information → Details.

steps.title: Menu → Patients
steps.details: Patient list; tapping one opens their record on the right.

steps.title: Open their record
steps.details: Tap the patient in the list. The guide continues once their record is open.

steps.title: Details
steps.details: The form with all the patient's details.

steps.title: Phone
steps.details: With country code; it's the number for reminders.

steps.title: Responsible contact
steps.details: Only if they're a dependent: who the notices are sent to.

steps.title: Save changes
steps.details: Saves the details. If the email or phone already belongs to another patient, it warns you first.
